sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of 'Breakfast' are simple yet engaging. The game is centered around cooking and customizing pancakes, and the process is divided into several steps. First, you need to gather ingredients, such as flour, sugar, butter, baking soda, milk, and egg. These ingredients can be gathered by clicking on the respective icons on the screen. Once you have all the necessary ingredients, you can mix them together to create a batter. After mixing the ingredients, you need to bake the pancake in the oven. The game provides a timer to help you avoid burning the pancake. Once the pancake is baked, you can decorate it with a variety of toppings and decorations. The game also includes a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can be used to enhance your gameplay experience.

One of the key features of 'Breakfast' is its intuitive controls. The game uses a simple point-and-click system, where you can click on the ingredients and decorations to add them to your pancake. The game also includes a variety of shortcuts and hotkeys that can be used to speed up the gameplay experience. The gameplay experience is further enhanced by the game's various features and modes.
